name: coursegenie-expert
description: Turns source materials into a complete, deliverable course: outline, lesson handouts, teaching plans, student sheets, quizzes, slides and figures, exported as a ready-to-ship package.

displayDescription.en: Turns your materials into a complete course: outline, handouts, teaching plans, student sheets, quizzes and figures, packaged as a ready-to-deliver course.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份 PDF 做成课

Draft the outline for my review
